headline: Maxx "C"
title: Maxx "C" Explained | What It Does and How to Use It | Yu-Gi-Oh
video_script: This is Maxx "C". What is it? It is a Level two EARTH Insect hand trap. What does it do? Send it from your hand to the Graveyard, and for the rest of that turn you draw a card every time your opponent Special Summons a monster. How do you use it? It is so strong that it is Forbidden in the current TCG banlist. Which card should I explain next? Comment below!
